blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Rancho Santa Margarita
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: Rancho Santa Margarita is a dense but nightlife-light master-planned community with winding streets and cul-de-sacs a coach cannot easily navigate or park in.
RSM Town Center is the one real late-evening draw and its lots fill by evening.
Lago Santa Margarita's fireworks and tree-lighting events end at a fixed time with thousands of cars leaving a limited number of access roads, so a coach clears the lot before the surge.
The city sits about 10-15 minutes from both Dana Point and Laguna Niguel, so cross-town evening runs are routine.

blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Rancho Santa Margarita Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.
